name: M7.SignatureTau.tau_principal
statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], ∀ (u : (ZMod N)ˣ) (F : M6.Cyclic.BinaryPolynomial), M7.SignatureIdeal.principal N (M7.SignatureTau.tau u F) = (M7.SignatureIdeal.principal N F).map (M7.QuotientAuto.substitution u)
guidance: Unfold tau and reverse accepted SignatureIdeal.principal_gcd. Ideal.map_span and Set.image_singleton reduce to the actual accepted polynomial_substitution equality. This equality is between actual ideals and keeps every repeated factor. Return tactic lines only without leading by.
